name: Read Aloud
author: LastAi
description: Adds a speaker button to dialogs (events, station contacts, encounters) that reads the latest text aloud. Uses your system voice out of the box: a narrator plus male and female character voices, optionally a voice pool so each character keeps their own voice. For AI voices (Kitten TTS, F5-TTS, Chatterbox), add the optional Read Aloud: AI Voices mod. Safe to add to or remove from a save.
